a: Fourier analysis represents functions as sums of sinusoids.
Laplace transforms help solve differential equations.
Differential equations relate functions to their derivatives.
Separation of variables solves some differential equations.
Span is all linear combinations of a set of vectors.
Projection finds the closest vector in a subspace.
Orthonormal sets are orthogonal and unit length.
|det| relates to volume scaling of linear transforms.
A square matrix is invertible iff determinant ≠ 0.
Condition number estimates sensitivity to input perturbations.
